sentences.text: Rule twenty-six covers vessels engaged in fishing, whether underway or at anchor.
A trawler shows two all-round lights, green over white.
She also shows a masthead light abaft of and higher than the green light, though a vessel under fifty meters isn’t required to.
A vessel fishing other than trawling shows red over white.
When her outlying gear extends more than one hundred fifty meters horizontally, she adds an all-round white light in the direction of the gear.
In both cases, when making way through the water, she adds sidelights and a sternlight.
